purpose: Six non-card concepts: creature scales and proposed peoples
canon_status: Creator requested setting catalogue inclusion for selected concepts. Opaline Kin explicitly excluded; Stonehorn developing; detailed ecology remains proposed where noted.
approved_preferences: Story and image reinforce one another. Across the Silence is a strong positive reference because its figure, gold thread, distance and light make the gods and summoner connection visible.
Grand landscapes can include a small character to establish scale, point of view and emotional stakes. A figure need not fill the frame.
Some abstraction is welcome, especially for mystery, metaphysical ideas or enormous scale. Use it occasionally rather than making it the default for every image.
Lighting should organize the scene and link its subjects. The Still Flame's dynamic warm light, visible brush strokes, integrated characters and small opening of blue sky are specifically loved.
Absorbed, purposeful activity is highly effective. In Light Without an Answer, the inventor's involvement in the lighting experiment and her small construct companion make the scene compelling.

Inventive creatures and constructs should feel like participants in the world. The little helper's design and role are strongly liked; preserve that functional imagination without repeating its exact anatomy or every scene's workshop.

Alignment identity can be clear without being heavy-handed. Light Without an Answer reads as Gnosis/blue through its activity, materials, light and palette without relying on all-blue colouring or repeated emblems.

Keep the economical, visible painted treatment of these approved concepts. Use meaningful selected detail, natural faces and varied brush scale; do not return to uncanny facial or surface microdetail.

images.title: Coalback Forager
images.proposal: A small heat-tolerant burrowing animal that gathers warm charcoal into insulated nests; a plausible camp neighbour for travelling bands.
images.story: Small creatures adapting to everyday life among the new kingdoms and free bands.
images.test: Personality through useful behaviour, warm/cool lighting, an inventive compact silhouette.
images.brief:
Paint a small original COALBACK, roughly ferret-length, caught tugging a single warm charcoal twig from the edge of a travellers' cooling cookfire. It is a living organic wild animal: a supple mustelid-like body, broad rust-coloured overlapping keratin plates over its shoulders and back, a softly furred soot-brown face, small alert ears, strong digging forepaws and a thick tapering tail. The plates form a simple arched silhouette like folded leaves, not a metallic robot or a familiar real-world species. Four believable legs. Ordinary dark eyes, curious concentration rather than a cartoon smile.

LOW, INTIMATE ground-level composition, animal facing LEFT with its head turned down to the twig it grips in its mouth. The head and forepaws take the focal attention; grouped plates and fur are rendered with broad strokes. A battered cooking pot, just one boot-sized tent peg and an out-of-focus bedroll imply the scale and travelling camp. No foreground human hand. The twig has only a faint amber warmth, not a magical flame or sparks. It has already set a second cooled twig beside its little burrow.

Light and colour: first cool blue morning on the ground, a small orange glow from the dying coals beneath its muzzle and paws, russet plates and pale dry grass. One muted teal cloth shape can supply colour contrast in the distant camp. Background suggested in a few masses, no rows of tents or army. A natural, characterful creature making its living in this world; endearing without a mascot face.

images.title: Reedcrown Grazer
images.proposal: An amphibious grazer with broad water-supporting feet and soft sensory fronds; proposed wildlife of the rivers.
images.story: A living river ecosystem through which people travel, giving Genesis room beyond trees and vines.
images.test: Biological invention, an animal-scale scene, cool colour with warm light and natural action.
images.brief:
Paint a pony-sized REEDCROWN grazing knee-deep in a quiet river bend. Invent a coherent amphibious herbivore rather than dressing a deer in plants: four long jointed legs ending in broad splayed webbed feet; a compact graceful body with smooth muted slate-teal skin, a long flexible neck, a broad soft muzzle, small dark mammalian eyes and two tapering sensory crests like flexible folded reeds growing behind the head. The crests are living anatomical structures, softly ribbed and semi-translucent, not actual branches or antlers. Its muscular tail curves low over the water. Interesting, gentle but wild.

Medium-wide side view, body facing RIGHT but neck arched down and back LEFT as it pulls a floating clump of riverweed from the current. Water hangs from its muzzle in a few painted accents; ripples visibly spread from its broad feet. Keep the whole body and all feet in the scene. One distant ferry with a tiny standing traveller is a low-contrast scale hint, not a second focal subject.

The banks are simple tawny reeds and one cool dark willow mass, opening to a wedge of pale peach morning sky reflected in the water. Teal, slate blue and pale jade with warm peach and a restrained rust accent in the crests. Low light shines through one thin crest, revealing its function and softness. Strong painted shapes, not engraved anatomy. No magic, armour, riders, giant horns, snarling or copied familiar animal. The river itself supplies the sense of a larger world.

images.title: Dawnsail Passage
images.proposal: A vast atmospheric glider; its precise biology and origin remain open. A creature, not a god or Velunn.
images.story: Wonder in the living world after the Silence, shown through a traveller's encounter with something much larger.
images.test: Grand landscape with a tiny character, beautiful lighting, restrained abstraction used selectively.
images.brief:
Paint the passage of a DAWNSAIL above a vast sea-cliff landscape. This is an immense living creature, cathedral-sized, gliding silently through a break in low clouds. Design an original aerial animal with a broad streamlined body, a gently bowed pale underside and two huge translucent sail-like fins extending sideways, backed by a few simple visible supporting ribs. A long tapering tail and small forward sensory lobes complete the coherent silhouette. Think of weight, lift and living membrane, not a flying sailing ship, dragon, giant bird, mechanical aircraft, monster face or cosmic god. Keep its small eyes and mouth barely indicated. Its skin is weathered pearl-grey, fins tinged warm ochre where sunlight passes through.

WIDE LANDSCAPE: the creature occupies the upper-left and middle distance, travelling LEFT across the scene, partly emerging from soft cloud. Its scale comes from a very small solitary traveller at the lower-right edge on a grassy coastal path, paused mid-step to look up. The person is only a few convincing paint marks, no heroic pose or visible magic.

A shaft of dawn light opens between large blue-grey cloud masses and makes one sail a luminous pale-gold plane. Far below, a quiet jade sea and simple layered cliffs recede in cool atmospheric shapes. Plenty of breathing room. A few sweeping forms can verge on abstraction, as in a grand painted landscape, while the anatomy and scale remain readable. Strong warm/cool contrast, delicate distant peach light and varied deep blue shadows. No full cities, ruins everywhere, glittering particles, stars, golden threads, portals or gods. This is natural wonder, not a retelling of Across the Silence's exact composition.

images.title: Stonehorn Bridgekeeper
images.proposal: Ibex-inspired people with practical grasping hands and sure-footed legs; the bridgekeeper is one individual, not a universal racial occupation or alignment.
images.story: Travel, care and infrastructure being maintained between the new kingdoms.
images.test: A dignified animal people comparable in seriousness to the lion folk, purposeful hands and contextual action.
images.brief:
Invent a dignified STONEHORN person: tall, rangy and ibex-inspired, with a genuinely caprine face, long swept-back ridged horns, short cream-and-umber facial fur, a small beard, alert natural eyes and sure-footed cloven lower legs. The torso and grasping hands are adapted for practical work, with believable joints and dark nails, not human hands stuck awkwardly onto goat feet. A person with intelligence and agency, not a faun caricature, demon, mascot or a human wearing a horned hat. Worn cream linen sleeves, a slate-blue waistcoat, a plain leather tool belt and short practical leg wraps make a culturally lived-in silhouette. No armour, heraldry or excessive jewellery.

Show this individual actively repairing a rope footbridge above a narrow gorge. Three-quarter medium-wide view from slightly above one side, whole figure visible near the left of the composition. They lean into tightening a heavy rope knot around a weathered wooden bridge post, both hands committed to the same task, eyes on the tensioned knot, one hoof naturally braced on the solid bank. A coiled rope and two replacement planks suffice for tools. One loosely painted human traveller waits at the far end, giving a sense of cooperation and scale.

Light: clear late-morning sun on the cream shirt and horn edge, cooler blue reflected light from the gorge, a small patch of saturated clear sky and pale distant limestone. Bridge ropes and sunlight guide the eye toward the working hands. The mountains and gorge are implied by a few broad planes, not a panoramic fortress. Visible brushwork, purposeful posture and calm competence; the scene communicates a people living in this world, not a character selection pose.

images.title: Opaline Kin — The Window Mender
images.proposal: People whose skin includes broad smooth opaline regions; origin and relation to the Cataclysm are deliberately undecided.
images.story: Ordinary rebuilding and craft performed by visibly unusual people; strangeness belongs within daily life.
images.test: Human alteration without body horror, simple face treatment and lighting that reveals anatomy through action.
images.brief:
Invent an OPALINE KIN woman, one of a proposed altered-human people. Preserve natural human proportions and a warm, thoughtful human face. Parts of her cheek, neck, forearms and hands are smooth smoky-opal material, in broad softly translucent regions that merge naturally into warm brown living skin. A few gently pearlescent colour changes suggest the material. No networks of veins, cracks, jagged crystals, cut gemstones, missing flesh, metal parts, exposed bones or alien eyes. She is a living person, not a statue, robot, ghost or horror creature. Her origins remain unknown. Short loosely tied dark hair, simple rolled-sleeve moss-grey working clothes and an indigo apron.

An absorbed everyday action: she is fitting a small clear glass pane into a weathered wooden window frame in a modest house. Three-quarter waist-to-knee view from inside the room. One hand steadies the pane and the other carefully presses a wooden retaining strip into place. Her gaze follows the edge she is aligning. Show the hands simply but naturally, not a macro anatomy study. A shallow tray of tools sits below; no text on any tools. The window only needs a few rectangular divisions.

A slant of amber afternoon sunlight passes through her more translucent forearm and the pane, laying a soft violet-and-honey patch across the cool plaster. Light reveals her unusual nature as part of the task, without a separate magic gesture. Her face is quietly intent, with a few expressive brush marks. Colour palette: soft plum shadows, muted olive cloth, warm brown skin, pearly lavender translucency and a concentrated warm window light. Keep the room mostly suggested with broad simple shapes. No extra characters, no halo, no glowing summoner mark and no busy rainbow effects. Make her understandable and human, with one beautiful strange quality.

images.title: Alderkin Waterkeeper
images.proposal: Living alder-like people with flexible trunk bodies and root limbs; tending this watercourse is one individual's choice.
images.story: Genesis-like stewardship: redirecting an old imperial watercourse to support young life rather than simply destroying it.
images.test: Inventive organic anatomy, a small story in the action, dynamic dappled light and integration with the environment.
images.brief:
Invent an ALDERKIN, a living tree person about three metres tall. Its asymmetrical body grows as a flexible trunk divided into two rootlike legs, with branch arms that end in a few natural grasping root-fingers. A narrow head grows from the upper trunk, with two quiet dark knot-like eyes and a gently angled brow formed by wood growth. Let its attention and head tilt express thought; do not carve a detailed old human face into bark. A few drooping leafy branchlets form a modest crown, not a huge antler throne. Bark is painted in broad silver-grey and warm umber planes with moss-green creases; do not engrave every crack. It is a living person, not a person wearing wooden armour or a frightening dead ent.

Show it bent at the knees and waist, absorbed in moving a loose stone from an old shallow irrigation channel so water can flow toward several small saplings. One long hand tips the stone, the other rests on the bank for balance. The newly released clear water makes a small bright curve through the picture. One very small, loosely painted adult gardener a little farther back is settling a sapling into the wet soil; the two tasks feel cooperative. Tools and clothes are minimal, and the tree person needs no human costume.

Medium-wide view from slightly above and behind one shoulder, with the head visible in partial profile turned down toward the opening in the watercourse. The body and limbs form a flowing asymmetry, not a frontal superhero stance. Strong dappled late sunlight picks out shoulder, fingertips, fresh leaves and water against rich cool green shadows. A small wedge of clean blue sky through the canopy lifts the palette. A few fragments of old dressed stone imply the imperial origin of the watercourse; no full ruin or giant throne. Painterly depth with a handful of broad canopy shapes. Gentle purpose, living wild anatomy and visible action.
